name.zh: 第19屆金磚國家峰會（中國擔任主席國）

city.zh: 中國（主辦城市尚未公布）

title.en: New Delhi summit adopts New Delhi Declaration
title.zh: 新德里峰會通過《新德里宣言》

summary.en: At the 18th summit in New Delhi in September 2026, BRICS adopted the New Delhi Declaration by consensus and leaders discussed conflict in West Asia.
summary.zh: 2026年9月第18屆新德里峰會以共識通過《新德里宣言》，領袖們也討論了西亞衝突。

question.en: Can a group with members as different as India, China and Iran agree on common positions?
question.zh: 像印度、中國、伊朗這樣差異大的成員，能形成共同立場嗎？

title.en: China takes the 2027 chair with tech agenda
title.zh: 中國接任2027年主席國並主打科技議程

summary.en: India handed the chairship to China, which will host the 2027 summit and has proposed cooperation on AI and industry.
summary.zh: 印度將主席國交棒給中國；中國將主辦2027年峰會，並提出人工智慧與產業合作構想。

question.en: Will China's chairship change how other countries see BRICS?
question.zh: 中國擔任主席國，會改變其他國家對金磚的看法嗎？

text.en: BRIC foreign ministers first meet at UN
text.zh: 金磚四國外長首次於聯合國會面

text.en: First BRIC summit in Yekaterinburg, Russia
text.zh: 於俄羅斯葉卡捷琳堡舉行首屆峰會

text.en: South Africa joins; BRIC becomes BRICS
New Development Bank opens in Shanghai
text.zh: 新開發銀行於上海開業

text.en: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, UAE join; partner category created
text.zh: 埃及、衣索比亞、伊朗、阿聯加入；設立夥伴國

text.en: India hosts 18th summit; chair passes to China
text.zh: 印度主辦第18屆峰會，主席國交棒中國
